layout._comment: activeWindow is registered but unplaced; add { "id": "activeWindow" } to any section to bring it back.

workspaces._comment: Mirrors split-monitor-workspaces. monitorPriority MUST match the monitor_priority list in ~/.config/hypr/hyprland/plugins.lua, and perMonitor MUST match workspace_count.

theme._comment: 'dynamic' follows ~/.cache/hellwal/quickshell.json and recolours live on wallpaper change. Any other value loads theme/<name>.json - shipped: mocha, gruvbox.
theme.name: dynamic

japaneseReviews._comment: Review tracker for WaniKani/Bunpro/Anki. API tokens live in services/secrets.json (not this file); Anki counts need the AnkiConnect addon. The layout entry can override refreshIntervalSec, e.g. { "id": "japaneseReviews", "refreshIntervalSec": 120 }.
